remote_install_mode: canonical GitHub repository README handoff to thin-loader bootstrap

migration.notes: Removes third-party TinyURL dependency from the primary installer. The stable public install entrypoint is the canonical GitHub repository README, which hands execution to the existing thin loader. Runtime, account state, updater, onboarding, recovery and module behavior are otherwise unchanged.

notes: Canonical Installer Transport. A URL-shortener preview/interstitial cannot block installation because the public installer now begins at canonical GitHub. Third-party aliases are non-authoritative and optional.
